abstract.para: Learn how to resolve &selnx; AVC denials.

topic.para: When &selnx; denies permission to access an object, it creates an audit log using Access Vector Cache (AVC) denials.

Because &productname; defaults to permissive mode after installing &sap; patterns, administrators can identify and resolve potential security issues without disrupting the system. If you are running &hana;, resolving these violations is a required step before you transition the system to enforcing mode.
Search for the AVC denials with the ausearch utility by running the following command:
topic.screen: &prompt.root;ausearch -m AVC -ts boot type=AVC msg=audit(1784184190.493:34): avc: denied { name_connect } for pid=857 comm="erts_sched_1" dest=5432 scontext=system_u:system_r:init_t:s0 tcontext=system_u:object_r:postgresql_port_t:s0 tclass=tcp_socket permissive=1
